original: 何それ。\nどういう意味よっ？
traducao: What's that supposed to mean?\nExplain yourself!

original: だ、だから……。\n僕がここにいる事で、\n余計に君に迷惑をかけないかって……
traducao: I-I mean...\nDoesn't me being here with you\njust cause you more trouble...?

original: はぁ？
traducao: Huh?

original: あたしが一度でもそんなコト言った？\n言ってないでしょ？
traducao: Have I ever said anything like that?\nNo, I haven't!

original: それは……多分、\n僕に気を遣って……
traducao: That's... probably because\nyou're just being considerate...

original: あ〜〜も〜〜〜〜いいッッ！
traducao: Agh, whatever! Enough!

original: そう思いたいなら思ってれば？\nで、勝手にどこにでも\n行っちゃいなさいよ！
traducao: Think whatever you want!\nGo wherever you please,\nI don't care anymore!

original: ルカのばか！　ばーかばーか！！
traducao: Ruca, you idiot! Stupid, stupid!

original: お前さァ……。\nありゃ、どー考えたってマズイだろ……
traducao: Man...\nEither way you look at it, that was bad.

original: だって……、イリアはいつも\n僕といるとイライラしてるみたいなんだ
traducao: But... it always seems like Iria\nis annoyed whenever she's with me.

original: 迷惑ばかりかけて……、\n嫌な思いさせて……、\n僕……
traducao: I just cause her trouble...\nMake her feel miserable...\nI...

original: （見てらんねェぜ、コリャ……。\n　どうすっかな……）
traducao: (I can't just stand here and watch this...\nWhat should I do?)

original: クエスト「じれったい二人」が\nエントリーされました。\nスパーダから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest 'Irritating Pair'\nhas been added.\nYou can accept it from Spada.

original: 悪ィ、オレに協力してくんねェか？
traducao: My bad, mind giving me a hand?

original: あの二人……ルカとイリアなんだけどよ、\n傍から見ててキレそうになるくらい\nじれったくてよォ……
traducao: Those two... Ruca and Iria.\nWatching them is so frustrating,\nit's driving me crazy...

original: ここらで一旦、無理やりにでも\n互いにぶっちゃけ合うってェの？
traducao: We need to force them\nto spill their guts to each other.

original: そういう機会を作ってやんねえと、\nどうにもなんねぇ予感がしてよ
traducao: If we don't set something up,\nI got a feeling this'll go nowhere.

original: ま、そういうわけで\n○○の\n演技力には期待してるぜ？
traducao: So, with that in mind...\nI'm counting on your\nacting skills, got it, ○○?

original: オレがヤバくなったら、\nバッチリ陰からサポートしろよ！
traducao: If things start going south,\nmake sure you back me up from the shadows!

original: んじゃ、オレが適当言って\nあの二人を連れてくるから
traducao: Alright, I'll go make up some excuse\nto bring those two along.

original: さっさと出発しちまおーぜ！
traducao: Let's get going already!

original: あー、だる……
traducao: Ugh, so annoying...

original: 魔物退治くらい、あんたらだけで\nどーにかなるんじゃないのォ？
traducao: You guys could handle\na simple monster hunt on your own, right?

original: 何であたしまで……。\n何か、余計なオマケまで\n付いて来ちゃってるみたいだし〜？
traducao: Why do I have to come...?\nAnd it looks like we brought along\nsome useless dead weight, too.

original: まァ、そう言うなって。\n噂じゃ、なかなかに手強い魔物らしいぜ？
traducao: Come on, don't say that.\nRumor has it this one's pretty tough.

original: やっぱ、戦力は一人でも多い方が\nいいだろ？　なっ
traducao: It's better to have as many fighters\nas possible, right?

original: 僕なんかがいて……、\n余計足手まといにならないかな……？
traducao: I'm here...\nWon't I just be a burden to everyone...?

original: そうですわよねぇ〜〜
traducao: That's exactly right.

original: ルカちゃまはお部屋に篭もって、\nお勉強でもされてた方が\nよろしかったんじゃありませんこと〜〜？
traducao: Wouldn't it be better if\nlittle Ruca stayed locked in his room\nstudying instead of bothering us?

original: だーッ。\nもう、こんな入口で\nウダウダすんのはやめだッ！
traducao: Gah!\nEnough standing around the entrance\ncomplaining about this!

original: とっとと先に進もうぜ！
traducao: Let's just keep moving forward!

original: ったく、いつまで\nシケた面してンだよッ！
traducao: Jeez, how long are you gonna\nkeep that gloomy look on your face!?

original: お前がウジウジしてっから、\nいつまでもイリアと\n仲直り出来ねェんだろーが
traducao: Because you're always whining,\nyou'll never be able to\nmake up with Iria.

original: ……そうだよね……。\nどうせ、僕なんて……
traducao: ...You're right...\nI'm just useless, anyway...

original: ううっ、グス……
traducao: Ugh... sniff...

original: ああ、悪ィ……。\n今のはちっと、言い方が悪かった
traducao: Ah, my bad...\nI phrased that poorly just now.

original: 要するに、だ。\nどーすりゃいいかなんて、\n実はすげェ簡単なコトだっつー話
traducao: Basically.\nFiguring out what to do\nis actually a really simple thing.

original: お前さ、ビビり過ぎ。\nイリアにも、誰に対してもよ
traducao: You're way too scared.\nOf Iria, and of everyone else.

original: 相手の目を気にし過ぎて、\nかえって空回りしてるっつーか
traducao: You care too much about what others think,\nwhich just ends up making you spin tires.

original: 思われても言われてもねェコトを\n勝手に自分で作り上げちまってる
traducao: You're making up things in your head\nthat no one ever said or thought.

original: それが、\n全部の元凶なんじゃねーか？
traducao: Isn't that\nthe root of all your problems?

original: そう……かな？\nだって……
traducao: Is that... so?\nBut...

original: うん……。\n言われてる意味はわかるよ？
traducao: Yeah...\nI understand what you're saying.

original: でも……
traducao: But...

original: でもも、ヘチマもねェ！
traducao: No buts!

original: ひっ！！
traducao: Eek!!

original: いいから、そのウジウジを\n今すぐやめな！
traducao: Just stop that moping\nright this instant!

original: んで、気になる事があンなら\n本人に聞くなりなんなりしろ
traducao: And if you're worried about something,\nask the person directly.

original: 一人であんま、思い詰めんな
traducao: Don't bottle it all up by yourself.

original: そーいうの、寂しいっつーか\nムカつくだけだぜ。\nこっちはよ
traducao: Seeing you do that just makes me\nfeel sad, or rather, it pisses me off.\nUnderstand?

original: スパーダ……
traducao: Spada...

original: どうしたの？\n今日はやけに優しいね
traducao: What's gotten into you?\nYou're surprisingly gentle today.

original: バーカ
traducao: Idiot.

original: ダチってのはなァ、\nこういう時に助け合うモンなんだよ
traducao: Pals are supposed to help each other out\nin times like this.
Right, ○○?

original: あー、イライラするったら。\n何なのアイツ！
traducao: Argh, he's so irritating!\nWhat's his problem!?

original: ウジウジ、めそめそ、\nいじけてばっか
traducao: Always moping, whimpering,\nand sulking all the time.

original: そのくせ、他の女とは\nデレ〜っと鼻の下伸ばして\nお勉強会なんてやってやがんのよ！
traducao: And yet, when he's with other girls,\nhe gets all drooly and mushy,\nhaving stupid study sessions with them!

original: うぎぃぃ〜〜っ、腹立つゥ〜〜！！
traducao: Gaaaaah, it pisses me off!!

original: だったらそれ、\nそのまんまルカのヤツに\n言ってやれば良くねェ？
traducao: If that's the case,\nwhy don't you just tell\nRuca exactly that?

original: 「他の女と仲良くしてるのが\n　一番気に入らない」ってよ
traducao: Just say, 'I can't stand it when\nyou act friendly with other girls.'

original: 何よそれ！\nアンタ、あたしをバカにしてんの！？
traducao: What is that supposed to mean!?\nAre you making a fool out of me!?

original: オイオイ、オレに噛み付くなよ！\nこっちは心配して言ってんだぜ？
traducao: Hey, don't snap at me!\nI'm just saying this out of concern.

original: お前はいいのかよ。\nルカといつまでも、このまんまでよ？
traducao: Are you okay with this?\nStaying like this with Ruca forever?

original: それは……
traducao: Well...

original: アイツ、さっきも\nめそめそ泣いてたぜェ？
traducao: He was crying over this\njust a minute ago, you know?

original: ルカのヤツも相当いじけ虫だがよ、\nお前にももう少し……何だ、その\n別のやり方ってェのがあるんじゃねーの？
traducao: Ruca's a total crybaby, but...\ndon't you think you could try,\nI dunno, a different approach?

original: ……別のやり方……
traducao: ...A different approach...

original: そうね……、そうかも
traducao: Right... maybe you're right.

original: おっ。\nわかってくれ……
traducao: Oh.\nGlad you underst-

original: どうせ見るなら、とっておきの\nルカちゃまの泣き顔が見たいものねェ∀
traducao: If I'm gonna see him cry, I want to see\nlittle Ruca's very best crying face!

original: 中途半端に泣かせてる今の状態は\n確かにもったいないし？
traducao: Leaving him half-crying like this\nis definitely a waste, right?

original: こりゃ、早急に\n作戦を練る必要があるわね……。\nウヒヒヒヒヒヒヒ
traducao: I need to come up with\na strategy right away...\nUhehehehehehe!

original: お前……、\nそういう話ンなると\nほんっとイキイキするよなぁ……
traducao: Man...\nYou really perk up\nwhen it comes to stuff like this...

original: ふう。\nったく、驚かせんじゃねーっての……！
traducao: Phew.\nJeez, don't scare me like that...!

original: ホントよね……
traducao: Seriously...

original: あ、痛つつつつ……
traducao: Ow, ow, ow, ow...

original: イリア、大丈夫？\nどこか痛むの？
traducao: Iria, are you okay?\nDoes it hurt somewhere?

original: あ……あたしは別に……
traducao: I... I'm fine...

original: それよか、アンタの方が\nよっぽど怪我してんじゃないのよッ！
traducao: More importantly, you're\nthe one who's way more hurt!

original: え……。\nでもこれくらい……何ともないよ
traducao: Huh...\nBut this much is... nothing, really.

original: いーから見せなさいっての！！
traducao: Just let me see it!!

original: ったく……。\nルカのくせに、\n無茶するんだから……
traducao: Geez...\nYou're just Ruca, so stop doing\nsuch reckless things...

original: うん……、ごめん……
traducao: Yeah... I'm sorry...

original: ば、ばかっ。\n何謝ってんの？
traducao: I-Idiot.\nWhat are you apologizing for?

original: っていうか、むしろ……
traducao: I mean, if anything...

original: どうしたの……？
traducao: What's wrong...?

original: ルカッ！
traducao: Ruca!

original: は、はいっ？
traducao: Y-Yes!?

original: 助けてくれて、ありがと！！
traducao: Thanks for saving me!!

original: だから……、もー謝るのとかやめてよね。\n……お互いサマなんだから
traducao: So... stop apologizing already.\n...We're even now.

original: ……イリア……
traducao: ...Iria...

original: よくわからねェけど、\nうまくいったみてぇだな？
traducao: I don't really get it,\nbut it looks like things worked out, huh?

original: 一時はどうなるかと思ったけど……。\nま、結果オーライか！
traducao: I wasn't sure what'd happen for a bit...\nBut hey, all's well that ends well!

original: ふーっ、やっと帰ってきたぁ♪
traducao: Phew, we're finally back!

original: うん……。\n何だか、ここに戻ってくると\nちょっと落ち着くね
traducao: Yeah...\nSomehow, coming back here\nmakes me feel a bit calmer.

original: そーねぇ。\n半分もう、あたし達の\n家みたいなものなのかもね
traducao: Yeah.\nIt's practically half like a home\nto us already.

original: 家、か……
traducao: A home, huh...

original: へへっ。\n悪かァねえなぁ？\nそういうのもよ
traducao: Heh.\nNot too shabby, right?\nI could get used to that.

original: みんな、ご苦労様。\nその様子だと収穫あったみたいね
traducao: Good work, everyone.\nLooks like it was a fruitful trip.

original: モチのロンよぉ〜。\n楽勝だって！
traducao: Of course it was!\nIt was a piece of cake!

original: そう。\nそれは良かった
traducao: I see.\nThat's wonderful to hear.

original: それじゃ、早速だけど\n無断外出した理由を\n聞かせてもらってもいい？
traducao: Well then, let's get right to it.\nMind explaining why you all sneaked\nout without permission?

original: 無断……外出？
traducao: Without... permission?

original: どうして？\nだってスパーダ、\nギルドで正式に受けた依頼って……
traducao: Why?\nBut Spada said it was an official\nguild request...

original: ふうん。\nそう……、スパーダ君はそんな風に\n言ってたのね
traducao: Hmm.\nI see... so that is what\nSpada told you.

original: って事は……。\nでっちあげの理由で、あたし達を\n外に連れ出したってこと？
traducao: Which means...\nHe dragged us out here with a\ncompletely made-up excuse!?

original: うぎぃぃいい！　何ソレ！\n騙したってわけ！？
traducao: Gaaaaah! What the heck!\nHe tricked us!?

original: ちょっと、スパーダ！
traducao: Hey, Spada!

original: っていないし！？\nアイツ……！
traducao: He's already gone!?\nThat jerk...!

original: ウフフ。\n何となく、事情は飲み込めたけど
traducao: Hehehe.\nI think I understand the situation, but...

original: ……もう、しょうがないなぁ
traducao: ...Geez, I suppose it can't be helped.

original: 後でたっぷり\nお説教しなくちゃね∀
traducao: I'll just have to give him\na thorough lecturing later on.

original: この辺に魔物が\n出るって話だったのよね？
traducao: Wasn't this where\nthe monsters were supposed to appear?

original: んで？　どこにいんのよ？
traducao: So? Where are they?

original: い……、いきなりはやっぱり\n出て来ないんじゃないかな……
traducao: I... I doubt they'll just\npop out right away...

original: せめてこう、\n相手の興味を引く事をするとか\nテリトリーを荒らすとかしないと……
traducao: We'd have to do something\nto grab their attention, or\nmaybe invade their territory first...

original: あそ。\nじゃ、決まりね
traducao: I see.\nThen it's decided.

original: その囮役はルカに決定ー♪
traducao: Ruca, you're going to be our decoy!

original: ええっ！\n何でそうなるのさぁ〜
traducao: Eeeh!?\nWhy does it have to be me!?
Hey, ○○!

original: あいつらが話し込んでるスキに、\nこっからずらかるぜ！
traducao: Let's get out of here while\nthose two are busy bickering!

original: ちょっ、何、今の？
traducao: Hey, what was that just now?

original: 危ない、イリア！！
traducao: Look out, Iria!!

original: ンだよ、マジでここは\n化け物の巣だったってか！？
traducao: What the hell, was this place seriously\na monster nest all along!?

original: チックショウ、やるっきゃねえか……
traducao: Dammit, guess we have no choice...

original: ○○、援護頼むぜ！\n遅れんなよ！？
traducao: ○○, back me up!\nDon't fall behind!?

original: へっ、律儀なこった。\nココでオレ達の帰りを\n待ってたってかァ？
traducao: Heh, how polite.\nWere you waiting right here\nfor us to come back?

original: ……上等だぜ！\n覚悟しやがれ！！
traducao: ...Bring it on!\nGet ready!!
